section: Five Year Plans I to XII - objectives, targets, achievements and failures of each
subsections: Plan → GDP growth target vs achieved; highest-growth plan

accepted.s: Which one of the following was the principal objective of the Fifth Five Year Plan?
accepted.x: The Fifth Five Year Plan emphasised removal of poverty, self-reliance and control of inflation.
accepted.tq: Direct recall of the plan’s distinctive objective.

accepted.s: Which Five Year Plan gave primary emphasis to Human Resource Development?
accepted.x: Human resource development was the main objective of the Eighth Five Year Plan.
accepted.tq: Direct plan-and-objective matching.

accepted.s: The objective ‘Growth with Social Justice and Equity’ is associated with the:
accepted.x: The Ninth Five Year Plan focused on growth with social justice and equity.
accepted.tq: Identify the plan from its characteristic tagline.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the objectives of the Five Year Plans:
1. The Fifth Plan emphasised removal of poverty and self-reliance.
2. The Seventh Plan focused on food, work and productivity.
3. The Eighth Plan focused on human resource development.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements correctly state the principal objectives of the Fifth, Seventh and Eighth Plans respectively.
accepted.tq: Combine three closely related plan-objective pairs and verify each statement.

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
o: Ninth Plan — Growth with social justice and equity
Seventh Plan — Food, work and productivity
Fifth Plan — Removal of poverty and self-reliance
accepted.x: Human resource development was the principal objective of the Eighth Plan, whereas the Tenth Plan targeted 8 per cent GDP growth and doubling of per capita income in ten years.
accepted.tq: Find the wrong plan-objective pair by eliminating the familiar correct matches.

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes the objective of the Tenth Five Year Plan?
o: Faster, sustainable and more inclusive growth
Growth with stability and progressive self-reliance
8 per cent GDP growth and doubling of per capita income in ten years
Removal of poverty and technological self-reliance
accepted.x: The Tenth Plan targeted 8 per cent GDP growth and sought to double per capita income within ten years.
accepted.tq: Direct recall of a numerical target linked with a plan.

accepted.s: Which Five Year Plan was described as the last Five Year Plan of India?
accepted.x: The Twelfth Five Year Plan, covering 2012–17, was the last Five Year Plan.
accepted.tq: Direct recall of a terminating institutional phase.

accepted.s:
Arrange the following plans in chronological order of their periods:
A. Eighth Five Year Plan
B. Fifth Five Year Plan
C. Tenth Five Year Plan
D. Seventh Five Year Plan
accepted.x: The Fifth, Seventh, Eighth and Tenth Plans covered 1974–79, 1985–90, 1992–97 and 2002–07 respectively.
accepted.tq: Arrange plans by their stated periods, using the earliest and latest items first.

accepted.s: The First Five Year Plan was formally launched on:
accepted.x: The First Five Year Plan was launched on 1 April 1951.
accepted.tq: Numerical date recall with closely placed alternatives.

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly represents the period of the Fifth Five Year Plan?
accepted.x: The Fifth Five Year Plan was scheduled for 1974–79, although it ended in 1978.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the scheduled plan period from the year of early termination.

accepted.s: The Fifth Five Year Plan ended before its scheduled completion in:
accepted.x: Although the Fifth Plan was scheduled for 1974–79, it ended in 1978.
accepted.tq: Test the exceptional end year rather than the normal five-year span.

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes the Annual Plans associated with the transition to the Eighth Five Year Plan?
o: They covered 1990–92, after which the Eighth Plan began in 1992.
They covered 1985–90 and preceded the Seventh Plan.
They covered 1966–69 and immediately preceded the Fourth Plan.
They covered 1978–80 and were revised every year.
accepted.x: Annual Plans were implemented in 1990–91 and 1991–92, and the Eighth Plan began in 1992.
accepted.tq: Separate Annual Plans from the similarly named Plan Holiday and Rolling Plan.

accepted.s: The Twelfth Five Year Plan was launched on:
accepted.x: The Twelfth Five Year Plan was launched on 1 April 2012 and covered 2012–17.
accepted.tq: Direct recall of a plan launch date.

accepted.s: The plan system in India, as represented by the First to Twelfth Five Year Plans, extended from:
accepted.x: The Five Year Plan system ran from 1951 to 2017, ending with the Twelfth Plan.
accepted.tq: Test the complete chronological span of the planning era.

accepted.s: The Eleventh Five Year Plan had a GDP growth target of:
accepted.x: The original GDP growth target of the Eleventh Plan was 9 per cent, later revised to 8.1 per cent.
accepted.tq: Recall the original target while distinguishing it from the revised target and achievement.
accepted.sec: Plan → GDP growth target vs achieved; highest-growth plan  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which Five Year Plan recorded the highest GDP growth among the plans listed?
accepted.x: The Eleventh Five Year Plan recorded the highest GDP growth, with actual growth of about 8 per cent.
accepted.tq: Compare actual growth figures across successive plans.
accepted.sec: Plan → GDP growth target vs achieved; highest-growth plan  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following plans recorded the lowest actual GDP growth?
accepted.x: The Third Plan recorded actual growth of about 2.2 per cent, the lowest among the listed plans.
accepted.tq: Identify the extreme value from the plan-wise achievement figures.
accepted.sec: Plan → GDP growth target vs achieved; highest-growth plan  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about plan-wise GDP growth:
1. The First Plan exceeded its target growth rate.
2. The Third Plan exceeded its target growth rate.
3. The Seventh Plan exceeded its target growth rate.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The First Plan achieved 3.6 per cent against a target of 2.1 per cent, and the Seventh achieved 6 per cent against 5 per cent. The Third achieved only 2.2 per cent against its 5.6 per cent target.
accepted.tq: Compare target and achievement rather than relying on the plan’s objective.
accepted.sec: Plan → GDP growth target vs achieved; highest-growth plan  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Which of the following pairs is correctly matched with respect to target and actual GDP growth?
1. First Plan — 2.1 per cent target and 3.6 per cent actual
2. Third Plan — 5.6 per cent target and 2.2 per cent actual
3. Tenth Plan — 8 per cent target and 7.7 per cent actual
accepted.x: All three pairs are correct: the First, Third and Tenth Plans recorded the stated target and actual growth rates.
accepted.tq: Verify target-achievement pairs individually before selecting the coded combination.
accepted.sec: Plan → GDP growth target vs achieved; highest-growth plan  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which Five Year Plan recorded actual GDP growth of approximately 6.0 per cent against a target of 5.0 per cent?
accepted.x: The Seventh Plan achieved about 6.0 per cent growth against its target of 5.0 per cent.
accepted.tq: Match a paired target-and-achievement figure to the correct plan.
accepted.sec: Plan → GDP growth target vs achieved; highest-growth plan  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Eighth Five Year Plan achieved actual GDP growth of approximately:
accepted.x: The Eighth Plan recorded actual GDP growth of approximately 6.68 per cent, against a target of 5.6 per cent.
accepted.tq: Use the distinctive decimal achievement to distinguish adjacent plans.
accepted.sec: Plan → GDP growth target vs achieved; highest-growth plan  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following plans had a target growth rate of 7 per cent and achieved approximately 5.4 per cent growth?
accepted.x: The Ninth Plan initially had a 7 per cent target and achieved about 5.4 per cent growth; the later target was stated as 6.5 per cent.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the original target from the later revised target.
accepted.sec: Plan → GDP growth target vs achieved; highest-growth plan  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Which of the following statements regarding the Eighth Five Year Plan is correct?
1. Per capita national output grew by about 3.9 per cent annually.
2. Agricultural growth was about 3.6 per cent against a target of 3.5 per cent.
3. Industrial growth was about 8.5 per cent against a target of 8.1 per cent.
accepted.x: All three statements correctly describe the Eighth Plan’s per capita output, agricultural growth and industrial growth performance.
accepted.tq: Read sectoral target-achievement data together rather than separately.
accepted.sec: Plan → GDP growth target vs achieved; highest-growth plan  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which group contains only those Five Year Plans that exceeded their GDP growth targets?
o: First, Second, Fifth, Seventh and Eighth
Second, Fifth, Sixth, Eighth and Ninth
First, Third, Sixth, Seventh and Tenth
First, Fifth, Sixth, Seventh and Eighth
accepted.x: The First, Fifth, Sixth, Seventh and Eighth Plans achieved growth above their respective targets.
accepted.tq: Identify the complete set by comparing each target with its achievement.
accepted.sec: Plan → GDP growth target vs achieved; highest-growth plan  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The largest shortfall between targeted and actual GDP growth occurred during the:
accepted.x: The Third Plan targeted 5.6 per cent growth but achieved only about 2.2 per cent, mainly reflecting the plan’s failure during wars and droughts.
accepted.tq: Compare the gap between target and achievement, not merely the actual growth rate.
accepted.sec: Plan → GDP growth target vs achieved; highest-growth plan  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Twelfth Five Year Plan had which of the following growth targets in its final formulation?
accepted.x: The Twelfth Plan had a 9 per cent target in the Approach Paper, but the final target was fixed at 8 per cent.
accepted.tq: Distinguish an approach-paper proposal from the final approved target.
accepted.sec: Plan → GDP growth target vs achieved; highest-growth plan  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly states the actual GDP growth achieved during the Tenth Five Year Plan?
accepted.x: The Tenth Plan targeted 8 per cent growth and achieved approximately 7.7 per cent.
accepted.tq: Separate a plan’s target from its actual achievement.
accepted.sec: Plan → GDP growth target vs achieved; highest-growth plan  [APPSC]
